news_highlights.title: Compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI Installs a Credential Stealer and Backdoor
news_highlights.why_it_matters: The poisoned wheel ran on every Python start and specifically harvested Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and MCP config tokens plus SSH and cloud keys. If any agent setup pulled litellm 1.107.0 on Oct 21, rotate those credentials; 1.106.2 and the rc builds are clean.

news_highlights.title: Today's PHP security release, and how we're strengthening security
news_highlights.why_it_matters: Two remote code execution bugs across the whole PHP 8.x line, confirmed against WordPress and Drupal, and a disclosure leak means exploits are already circulating. Any PHP client site needs the patched release now.

news_highlights.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover vulnerabilities
news_highlights.why_it_matters: The PHP bugs were found with frontier models, and OpenAI ships a PHP version checker as a Codex skill. It's a concrete sign that agent-driven bug hunting is now producing internet-scale findings, and that more are coming.

news_highlights.title: Claude Duet
news_highlights.why_it_matters: Anthropic's proactive agent (research preview, US Pro/Max, iOS and Android) works on its own cloud computer, sends a morning brief and asks before sending or paying. It shows where always-on assistants are heading beyond chat.

news_highlights.title: The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure
news_highlights.why_it_matters: GitHub explains moving almost all repositories to Azure with per-reference quorums and object storage so reads scale independently, infrastructure built for the load that fleets of coding agents put on Git.
